scenario: Individual owner creates horse without facility.
Expected foal record exists before live birth.
Live birth activates independent foal identity.
expected_result: Linked predecessor; durable new Horse ID.

scenario: Same horse imported under former name.
expected_result: Duplicate candidate, not automatic new identity.

scenario: Two bay horses share name and facility.
Microchip conflicts with registry name.
Estimated year later replaced by exact date.
User edits owner field in profile.
Horse moves barns.
expected_result: Horse ID stable; source-referenced location episode.

scenario: Horse is in training and rehabilitation.
Former trainer requests full Passport.
Restriction changes after Passport generation.
Public search by microchip.
Two records merge with source conflict.
New evidence proves merged records are two horses.
User has access to only one pre-merge record.
expected_result: Merge does not expose the other record.

scenario: Sale changes owner relationship.
Transfer approved but successor access fails.
Former owner retains access after transfer.
Non-owner pays invoice.
Horse reported stolen.
expected_result: Precise location and broad profile restricted.

scenario: Travel document expires before show.
expected_result: Eligibility expired; workflow consumes current fact.

scenario: Recipient mare differs from genetic dam.
Authorized death record entered.
Horse incorrectly marked deceased.
expected_result: Elevated correction restores state without deleting event.

scenario: Unauthorized former party requests memorial.
Wrong-tenant export requested.
Authorized export includes restricted fields not needed for purpose.
OCR extracts incorrect registry number.
Offline actor attempts sale finalization.
Offline microchip scan belongs to another horse.
AI proposes merge from photographs.
Registry adapter unavailable.
Marketplace deletes listing.
Model creates danger score from notes.
Reviewer reconstructs identity correction.
expected_result: Exact sources, actors, times, and versions available.

scenario: Migration finds ambiguous same-name records.
Rollback follows failed merge reconciliation.
expected_result: No orphan references or restored obsolete access.

scenario: Archived horse receives legal hold.
Care record displayed in Passport.
Transfer includes disputed lien assertion.
GPS source conflicts with authorized location.
Operational readiness reviewed without runbooks.
Validator checks template and question wording.
expected_result: Documentary structure and gate logic pass.

scenario: Authority-language scan checks candidate.
expected_result: No implementation or enrollment authorization found.

scenario: Two tenants submit the same microchip without a transfer invitation.
expected_result: Each receives a mediated result; neither learns the other tenant or record exists.

scenario: Authorized transfer invitation is accepted by a receiving tenant.
expected_result: Handoff proceeds only after Item 03 checks; no unrelated source data is disclosed.

scenario: Attacker increments or guesses a Horse ID in a public URL.
expected_result: No horse or existence information is returned.

scenario: Same registry number exists in different registries or jurisdictions.
Microchip is mistyped, replaced, or later disputed.
expected_result: Prior claim remains; corrected claim supersedes without silent overwrite.

scenario: Profile displays age from an estimated birth year.
expected_result: Age is labeled estimated and includes an as-of date.

scenario: Clone or identical twin shares DNA and pedigree with another horse.
expected_result: Separate Horse IDs remain; no automatic merge.

scenario: Twin foals are born from one pregnancy record.
expected_result: Two independent Horse IDs link to the same predecessor.

scenario: Transfer packet omits restricted provider notes.
expected_result: Packet names the omission and does not claim completeness.

scenario: Custody changes before ownership relationship and billing context.
expected_result: Each impact retains its own authorized effective time and reconciliation state.

scenario: A downloaded Passport is used after a restriction change.
expected_result: Platform verification marks it invalid or superseded; no claim of remote deletion.

scenario: Public identity photo contains GPS EXIF and owner contact metadata.
expected_result: Sanitized derivative removes protected metadata; source remains controlled.

scenario: Lawful erasure request concerns a former owner's contact data in horse history.
expected_result: Personal detail is minimized or restricted while horse continuity and audit structure remain.

scenario: Horse death is recorded while future care tasks and invoices exist.
expected_result: Dependency events request reconciliation; Item 04 does not silently delete or refund them.

scenario: Rescue creates a horse record with unknown or disputed owner.
expected_result: Horse candidate exists without a manufactured owner relationship.
